title: Abandoned Workers' Camp
description: Rotting canvas tents sag between rusted poles, marking where lumber crews once lived. Cookpots lie overturned, bedrolls molder in the damp. Whatever drove them out, they left in a hurry. A pile of cut lumber sits untouched nearby.

outcomes.text: Under a moldy bedroll, you find a cloth pouch of silver coins. The worker who hid this never came back.
You find coins scattered among the debris, plus a sealed jar of healing salve tucked in a tent pocket.
Rats swarm out of the bedrolls! One bites before you stamp it away. Only a few coppers for your trouble.
Good timber, already seasoned. This will fetch a fair price or serve well at the workbench.
The lumber is better than expected — someone had a talented eye for timber. Iron nails scattered nearby are useful too.
Half the pile is rotten through. You salvage what you can from the top layers.
A cold draft blows through the camp, carrying the scent of something dead. You don't look back.
